D5/S3/Quantum/Recovery/OrthogonalSyndrom.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Recovery.OrthogonalSyndromeDecoding.orthogonal_syndrome_recovery
D5/S3/Quantum/Recovery/OrthogonalSyndrom.signature: theorem orthogonal_syndrome_recovery (S : s → Matrix n d ℂ) (hS : OrthogonalSyndromes S) (sigma : Matrix s s ℂ) (rho : Matrix d d ℂ) : syndromeDecoding S (syndromeEncoding S sigma rho) = Matrix.trace sigma • rho
